source_caption_text:
J. Cole might not be retiring after all 👀

For years, Cole framed The Fall-Off as the final chapter of his career. But in a new GQ conversation with longtime executive Mark Pitts, he revealed that he’s done putting a retirement label on his future.

Cole admitted he originally approached the album thinking it would be his last, but that mindset started to change as he worked on the project and saw the reaction to his tour. Now, he’s leaving the door open for whatever comes next.

He’s not promising another album anytime soon, but one thing is clear: he’s no longer ruling it out.

And honestly, could knowing this was his final album have pushed Cole to make The Fall-Off his best work yet? Or is the possibility of more music even more exciting?

Would you want another J. Cole album after The Fall-Off, or should he leave on his own terms? 👇
